findings.conclusion: _block_basis is literal determinant/sign-layout extraction from the old cached structure, preserving canonical patterns, raw-M cap, per-pattern slices and union spinor order.

Cached and streamed builders use _block_pair_terms, which reuses the unchanged signed core-contracted Slater-Condon algebra. Generic nonreciprocal evaluators retain radial_symmetry=False. No small amplitude/connection filtering is introduced.

Connection iterator is ordered. indptr advances through all determinant rows, including empty rows; all connections with nonempty angular terms survive, including exact zero numeric sums. Separate DC and Breit sums are combined after contraction, matching the cached physical operators.

Cache key includes complete radial key and lives only inside immutable operator construction. Separate evaluator caches prevent stale source identity or DC/Breit aliasing. Finite real/complex scalar and declared dtype checks are retained.

Each CSF belongs to exactly one occupation pattern p and has determinant support only S_p. Therefore H_CSF[k,k]=c_k.T Hdet[S_p,S_p] c_k. Cross-pattern Hdet entries cannot enter that diagonal. Projection after column permutation preserves this support. Matvec retains Hdet in full, including cross-pattern entries.

Same orbitals and all signed CSF signatures/coupling trees give a literal principal restriction of Bfull to Afull. This removes only the explicit nine B-specific NR rows; all82 additional4f12 NR rows remain in A and B.

Use owned accepted13 A/B target eigenvectors as same-orbital reference embeddings; carry their already-qualified original531 tracking ancestry. Never directly index-embed the old531 coefficients across different orbitals.

For an isolated exact eigenvector, squared overlap>.5 outranks every omitted orthogonal vector by Bessel. Numerical residuals/Gram and the observed returned2-root gap qualify practical transport, not a rigorous omitted-spectrum gap certificate.
